scenario.sampling: shallow B/A/A/B per motion, then deep B/A

limits: Frozen production base excludes concurrent horse/touch/recovery work.
Shallow phase wrappers still add overhead.
Deep query counters add overhead; use them for work attribution, not the shallow timing comparison.
Elapsed wall time includes GC/preemption; p95 subphases cannot be added.
Two shallow samples per policy/motion do not establish sustained thermal performance or rare-hitch causality.
Keyboard walking does not prove native touch behavior or performance of the original saved world.
